understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces are selected and moved by clicking target positions or using directional movement. Movement is constrained by walls and obstacles; blocked moves do nothing but consume a step. Pieces can be pushed or repositioned when paths permit, and multiple pieces/goals must be handled without displacing pieces already on goals.
